test_scripts.check: pnpm architecture:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm ci:selftest && pnpm paper:test && pnpm gateway:test && pnpm test
test_scripts.paper:test: uv run --project services/paper --locked python -m unittest discover -s services/paper/tests
test_scripts.gateway:test: uv run --project services/gateway python -m unittest discover -s services/gateway/tests -p 'test_*.py'
test_scripts.memory-graph:test: uv run --project services/memory-graph --extra test pytest services/memory-graph/tests
test_scripts.evolve:test: uv run --project services/evolve --extra test --extra candidates pytest services/evolve/tests
test_scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm binary:test && pnpm --recursive test
